name: When should I consider replacing or adding new molding to my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing or adding new molding to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing or adding new molding for several reasons. If your existing molding is damaged, cracked, or outdated, new molding can significantly refresh your home's appearance. It's also a great way to add architectural detail and increase perceived value, especially in older homes lacking character. When undertaking a renovation, painting project, or flooring replacement, updating molding ensures a cohesive and finished look. Even a simple change can transform a plain room into a more elegant and inviting space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing or adding molding when it's damaged, outdated, or if you want to add architectural detail, refresh a room, or complete a renovation.
